entities.name: Reconfiguration Failure Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE when reconfiguration fails.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationFailure
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to indicate reconfiguration failure.

entities.name: Failure Cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for reconfiguration failure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state in which the UE operates during reconfiguration failure procedure.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the RRCReconfigurationFailure message.
The RRCReconfigurationFailure message contains the Failure Cause IE.
The reconfiguration failure procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
